title: Prove a two-region moment obstruction after carried-frame swaps (no new κ)
body:
After #4971 replaces three-ADD swaps with field exchanges carrying their frame labels, it leaves open whether chart rescheduling can reduce the paid recursive profile. This package proves that changing at most two intact source-defined constant-frame regions cannot improve the moment for any `0<t<1`, with the scalar chronology, literal signed native maps, center interfaces and endpoint charts fixed. **No new κ.**

The exact graph analysis checks both orientations, each with 768 free regions and 1,474 adjacent pairs. It exhausts 59,231 candidate assignments / 2,090 feasible assignments per orientation. Majorization and three written power inequalities certify every feasible comparison throughout the exponent range; nonadjacent pairs separate. None of the 1,438 identity-edge adjacent pairs admits constant-chart fusion. The source's full `{1:2201,2:412,3:510,4:127,5:40,8:8}` paid profile, 632 arbitrary inputs and 408 helper returns remain explicit.

The [proof](https://github.com/1337isnot1337/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5e1b9843f2b04cee1f4771fce2c62d0ac551d3d6/research/swap-contact-fusion-gate/PROOF.md), source pins and compressed complete witnesses are in `research/swap-contact-fusion-gate/`. Both registered Python 3.12.15 modes pass, including `-I -O`, signed operator/frame checks and rejection controls. The 18-file committed-byte preflight and official export integrity check pass. An optimized standalone replay of the exported bundle also passes with `PATH=/nonexistent`; all 19 export files stay byte-identical. [Hosted CI](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39908602185) also passes at exact head `5e1b9843f2b04cee1f4771fce2c62d0ac551d3d6`: planner and registered replay jobs succeed.

This does not exclude splitting a source zero-edge region, changing three or more regions, scalar rewrites, frame descents, new centers or changed native operators. Fresh physical phase lowering, full supplier/compiler/BIT/outer admission, Lean and independent human review are absent. The checkout is shallow, so full-history ancestry auditing is not claimed. The selected κ remains 0.00302015.

Scientific base `b91956876e5b4122fd89179f1b57557ff8378f15`; submission refreshed canonical main `bee95ce88f9f19802f0613f92838895cd0e14a1f`, with relevant guidance and consumed science inputs unchanged. Scope changes from the rank-shape card and concrete next questions are recorded in TASK.json. Submission overlap refresh covered 302 open PRs, 4,090 discussion records and all 6,636 tracked local note paths; this is bounded coverage, not a novelty guarantee. Only this isolated research package changes.
